segments.mn133:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati tapodārāme.
segments.mn133:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā samiddhi rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena tapodo [tapodā (sī.)] tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
segments.mn133:1.4: Tapode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno [sukkhāpayamāno (ka.)].
segments.mn133:1.5: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ tapodaṃ obhāsetvā yenāyasmā samiddhi tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā āyasmantaṃ samiddhiṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn133:2.2: “Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn133:2.3: Tvaṃ panāvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañcā”ti?
segments.mn133:2.4: “Ahampi kho, bhikkhu, na dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn133:2.5: Dhāresi pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattiyo gāthā”ti?
segments.mn133:2.6: “Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthāti.
segments.mn133:2.8: “Ahampi kho, bhikkhu na dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthāti.
segments.mn133:2.9: Uggaṇhāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca;
segments.mn133:2.10: pariyāpuṇāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca;
segments.mn133:2.11: dhārehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn133:2.12: Atthasaṃhito, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddeso ca vibhaṅgo ca ādibrahmacariyako”ti.
segments.mn133:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā samiddhi tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā samiddhi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn133:3.2: “Idhāhaṃ, bhante, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena tapodo tenupasaṅkamiṃ gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
segments.mn133:3.3: Tapode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsiṃ gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
segments.mn133:3.4: Atha kho bhante, aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ tapodaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā maṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn133:4.1: “Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ, bhante, taṃ devataṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn133:4.2: ‘na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn133:4.3: Tvaṃ panāvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañcā’ti?
segments.mn133:4.4: ‘Ahampi kho, bhikkhu, na dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn133:4.5: Dhāresi pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattiyo gāthā’ti?
segments.mn133:4.6: ‘Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthāti.
segments.mn133:4.8: ‘Ahampi kho, bhikkhu, na dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthāti.
segments.mn133:4.9: Uggaṇhāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca;
segments.mn133:4.10: pariyāpuṇāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca;
segments.mn133:4.11: dhārehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn133:4.12: Atthasaṃhito, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddeso ca vibhaṅgo ca ādibrahmacariyako’ti.
segments.mn133:4.15: Sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca desetū”ti.
segments.mn133:4.16: “Tena hi, bhikkhu, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.mn133:4.17: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā samiddhi bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.mn133:5.11: Na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
segments.mn133:5.15: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn133:6.2: idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
segments.mn133:7.1: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, acirapakkantassa bhagavato, etadahosi –
segments.mn133:7.2: “idaṃ kho no, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –
segments.mn133:7.13: Na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
segments.mn133:7.17: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn133:7.19: “Ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā”ti?
segments.mn133:7.21: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā mahākaccāno satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ;
segments.mn133:7.22: pahoti cāyasmā mahākaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
segments.mn133:7.23: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkameyyāma; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmā”ti.
segments.mn133:7.24: Atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākaccānena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
segments.mn133:7.25: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn133:7.26: “idaṃ kho no, āvuso kaccāna, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –
segments.mn133:7.29: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn133:7.31: “Tesaṃ no, āvuso kaccāna, amhākaṃ, acirapakkantassa bhagavato, etadahosi – idaṃ kho no, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –
segments.mn133:7.35: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn133:8.1: “Ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti?
segments.mn133:8.2: Tesaṃ no, āvuso kaccāna, amhākaṃ etadahosi –
segments.mn133:8.3: ‘ayaṃ kho āyasmā mahākaccāno satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
segments.mn133:8.4: Pahoti cāyasmā mahākaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
segments.mn133:8.5: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkameyyāma; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmā’ti.
segments.mn133:9.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva mūlaṃ atikkamma khandhaṃ sākhāpalāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya;
segments.mn133:9.2: evaṃ sampadamidaṃ āyasmantānaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etamatthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha [maññetha (pī.)].
segments.mn133:9.3: So hāvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato.
segments.mn133:9.4: So ceva panetassa kālo ahosi yaṃ bhagavantaṃyeva etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, yathā vo bhagavā byākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthā”ti.
segments.mn133:10.1: “Addhāvuso kaccāna, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato.
segments.mn133:10.2: So ceva panetassa kālo ahosi yaṃ bhagavantaṃyeva etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāma;
segments.mn133:10.3: yathā no bhagavā byākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma.
segments.mn133:10.4: Api cāyasmā mahākaccāno satthuceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ;
segments.mn133:10.5: pahoti cāyasmā mahākaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
segments.mn133:10.6: Vibhajatāyasmā mahākaccāno agaruṃ karitvā”ti [agarukaritvā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.mn133:11.1: “Tena hāvuso, suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.mn133:11.2: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahākaccānassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.mn133:12.1: “Yaṃ kho no, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –
segments.mn133:12.4: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn133:12.6: Imassa kho ahaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi –
segments.mn133:13.2: Iti me cakkhu ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti rūpāti – tattha chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ [chandarāgappaṭibandhaṃ (ka.)] hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto atītaṃ anvāgameti.
segments.mn133:13.4: Iti me sotaṃ ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti saddāti … pe … iti me ghānaṃ ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti gandhāti … iti me jivhā ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti rasāti … iti me kāyo ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti phoṭṭhabbāti … iti me mano ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti dhammāti – tattha chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto atītaṃ anvāgameti – evaṃ kho, āvuso, atītaṃ anvāgameti.
segments.mn133:14.2: Iti me cakkhu ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti rūpāti – tattha na chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, na chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa na tadabhinandati, na tadabhinandanto atītaṃ nānvāgameti.
segments.mn133:14.4: Iti me sotaṃ ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti saddāti … pe … iti me ghānaṃ ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti gandhāti … iti me jivhā ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti rasāti … iti me kāyo ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti phoṭṭhabbāti … iti me mano ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti dhammāti – tattha na chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, na chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa, na tadabhinandati, na tadabhinandanto atītaṃ nānvāgameti – evaṃ kho, āvuso, atītaṃ nānvāgameti.
segments.mn133:15.2: Iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti rūpāti – appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ paṇidahati, cetaso paṇidhānapaccayā tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.
segments.mn133:15.4: Iti me sotaṃ siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti saddāti … pe … iti me ghānaṃ siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti gandhāti … iti me jivhā siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti rasāti … iti me kāyo siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti phoṭṭhabbāti … iti me mano siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti dhammāti – appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ paṇidahati, cetaso paṇidhānapaccayā tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati – evaṃ kho, āvuso, anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.
segments.mn133:16.2: Iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti rūpāti – appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ nappaṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānapaccayā na tadabhinandati, na tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati.
segments.mn133:16.4: Iti me sotaṃ siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti saddāti … pe … iti me ghānaṃ siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti gandhāti … iti me jivhā siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti rasāti … iti me kāyo siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti phoṭṭhabbāti … iti me mano siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ iti dhammāti – appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ nappaṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānapaccayā na tadabhinandati, na tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati – evaṃ kho, āvuso, anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati.
segments.mn133:17.2: Yañcāvuso, cakkhu ye ca rūpā – ubhayametaṃ paccuppannaṃ.
segments.mn133:17.4: Tasmiṃ ce paccuppanne chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati.
segments.mn133:17.5: Yañcāvuso, sotaṃ ye ca saddā … pe … yañcāvuso, ghānaṃ ye ca gandhā … yā cāvuso, jivhā ye ca rasā … yo cāvuso, kāyo ye ca phoṭṭhabbā … yo cāvuso, mano ye ca dhammā – ubhayametaṃ paccuppannaṃ.
segments.mn133:17.11: Tasmiṃ ce paccuppanne chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati – evaṃ kho, āvuso, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati.
segments.mn133:18.2: Yañcāvuso, cakkhu ye ca rūpā – ubhayametaṃ paccuppannaṃ.
segments.mn133:18.4: Tasmiṃ ce paccuppanne na chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, na chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa na tadabhinandati, na tadabhinandanto paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati.
segments.mn133:18.5: Yañcāvuso, sotaṃ ye ca saddā … pe … yañcāvuso, ghānaṃ ye ca gandhā … yā cāvuso, jivhā ye ca rasā … yo cāvuso, kāyo ye ca phoṭṭhabbā … yo cāvuso, mano ye ca dhammā – ubhayametaṃ paccuppannaṃ.
segments.mn133:18.11: Tasmiṃ ce paccuppanne na chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, na chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa na tadabhinandati, na tadabhinandanto paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati – evaṃ kho, āvuso, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati.
segments.mn133:19.1: “Yaṃ kho no, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –
segments.mn133:19.4: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn133:19.6: “Imassa kho ahaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
segments.mn133:19.7: Ākaṅkhamānā ca pana tumhe āyasmanto bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, yathā vo bhagavā byākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthā”ti.
segments.mn133:20.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahākaccānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn133:20.2: “yaṃ kho no, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –
segments.mn133:20.5: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn133:20.7: Tesaṃ no, bhante, amhākaṃ, acirapakkantassa bhagavato, etadahosi –
segments.mn133:20.8: “idaṃ kho no, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –
segments.mn133:20.19: Na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
segments.mn133:20.23: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn133:20.25: “‘Ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā’ti?
segments.mn133:20.27: ‘ayaṃ kho āyasmā mahākaccāno satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
segments.mn133:20.28: Pahoti cāyasmā mahākaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
segments.mn133:20.29: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkameyyāma; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmā’ti.
segments.mn133:20.30: Atha kho mayaṃ, bhante, yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkamimha; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipucchimha.
segments.mn133:20.31: Tesaṃ no, bhante, āyasmatā mahākaccānena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi byañjanehi attho vibhatto”ti.
segments.mn133:21.2: Maṃ cepi tumhe, bhikkhave, etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, ahampi taṃ evamevaṃ byākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ mahākaccānena byākataṃ.
segments.mn133:21.3: Eso, cevetassa attho. Evañca naṃ dhārethā”ti.
segments.mn133:21.5: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.

lines: Tattha tapodārāmeti tattodakassa rahadassa vasena evaṃladdhanāme ārāme.

Vebhārapabbatassa kira heṭṭhā bhūmaṭṭhakanāgānaṃ pañcayojanasatikaṃ nāgabhavanaṃ devalokasadisaṃ maṇimayena talena ārāmauyyānehi ca samannāgataṃ, tattha nāgānaṃ kīḷanaṭṭhāne mahāudakarahado, tato tapodā nāma nadī sandati kuthitā uṇhodakā.
Rājagahaṃ kira parivāretvā mahā petaloko, tattha dvinnaṃ mahālohakumbhinirayānaṃ antarena ayaṃ tapodā āgacchati, tasmā sā kuthitā sandati.
“yatāyaṃ, bhikkhave, tapodā sandati, so daho acchodako sītodako sātodako setodako suppatittho ramaṇīyo pahūtamacchakacchapo, cakkamattāni ca padumāni pupphanti.
Apicāyaṃ, bhikkhave, tapodā dvinnaṃ mahānirayānaṃ antarikāya āgacchati, tenāyaṃ tapodā kuthitā sandatī”ti (pārā.231).
Imassa pana ārāmassa abhisammukhaṭṭhāne tato mahāudakarahado jāto, tassa nāmavasenāyaṃ vihāro tapodārāmoti vuccati.
Samiddhīti tassa kira therassa attabhāvo samiddho abhirūpo pāsādiko, tasmā samiddhitveva saṅkhaṃ gato.
Idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanāti madhupiṇḍikasutte (ma. ni.1.199 ādayo) vuttanayeneva vitthāretabbaṃ.
Iti me cakkhunti imasmiṃ kira sutte bhagavā dvādasāyatanavaseneva mātikaṃ ṭhapesi.

Theropi “bhagavatā heṭṭhā dvīsu, upari catutthe cāti imesu tīsu suttesu pañcakkhandhavasena mātikā ca vibhaṅgo ca kato, idha pana dvādasāyatanavaseneva vibhajanatthaṃ mātikā ṭhapitā”ti nayaṃ paṭilabhitvā evamāha.
Imaṃ pana nayaṃ labhantena therena bhāriyaṃ kataṃ, apade padaṃ dassitaṃ, ākāse padaṃ kataṃ, tena naṃ bhagavā imameva suttaṃ sandhāya –
“etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajantānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākaccāno”ti (a. ni.1.197) etadagge ṭhapesi.
Iti me mano ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ iti dhammāti ettha pana manoti bhavaṅgacittaṃ.

Edisāti kuthitā uṇhā, anvatthanāmavasena tapodāti ca vuccatīti attho.
